instruction.instruction_text: Walk straight through the doorway into the open living space, keeping a dining table and chairs on your left. Continue forward, passing a secondary doorway on your left. As you enter the main living room area, turn right to face the large window. Stop with the sofa and coffee table in front of you, and the TV wall on your left.

Walk forward, passing the kitchen counter on your right, and enter the living room. Proceed straight through the living room, keeping the dining table on your left and the sofa with a coffee table on your right. Turn left towards an open doorway on the left wall. Enter through the doorway into the next room, passing a bed on your left, and stop in front of the desk with a chair.

Walk straight down the hallway, passing an open doorway on your left. Enter the living room, keeping the grey couch on your left and an orange chair ahead. Turn right, passing a tall dark cabinet on your left, and enter the kitchen. Walk forward into the kitchen and stop in front of the counter with the cutting board.

Walk forward through the doorway into the hallway. Proceed straight down the hallway, passing a bathroom on your right. Then, turn left to enter the living room. Continue walking forward, with the grey couch and orange chair to your right, and stop in front of the window.

Walk straight down the hallway. Pass a doorway on your left, then pass a bathroom with a sink on your right. Continue straight to enter the living room. Walk past the gray sofa and the orange accent chair on your left, and stop facing the wooden paneled wall.

Walk straight down the hallway, passing the bathroom entrance on your right. Enter the main living area, keeping the grey couch and orange chair on your left. Continue forward with the wooden paneled wall on your left and a tall dark cabinet on your right, stopping in front of the dark wooden door.

Walk forward through the doorway to enter the living room, passing the kitchen counter on your right and a dining table on your left. Continue straight through the living room, keeping a gray sofa on your right, until you reach a hallway. Turn left into the hallway. Then, turn right into the bedroom, and walk forward until you stop in front of the bed, with a desk and a hanging chair positioned on your right.

Walk straight through the doorway, passing another doorway on your left and a bathroom entrance with a sink on your right. Enter the living room and adjust your path slightly to the right, stopping in front of the orange chair and the gray sofa, with a dark chest of drawers on your right.

Turn right into the living room, passing by a gray sofa and an orange chair on your left. Continue straight, passing a tall dark shelving unit on your right, and then stop in front of the closed door at the end of the passage, with the kitchen entrance on your right.

Walk forward, passing the white refrigerator and kitchen cabinets on your right. Continue straight into the open living and dining area, walking past the dining table and chairs on your right. Stop in front of the brown sofa in the living room.

From your starting position facing the sink, turn right, passing the toilet and window on your left, then continue turning right past the shower stall on your left, until you face the open doorway with a green abstract artwork on the wall to your right. Go through the doorway into the hallway. Walk straight down the hallway, passing an opening to a dining area on your right and a separate doorway on your left. Turn right into the next room, and stop in front of the toilet, with the window directly in front of you and the sink to your left.

Walk towards the doorway, keeping the kitchen area with the refrigerator on your right. Go through the doorway and proceed straight down the hallway, passing a dark green painting on your right and another green and white abstract painting on your left. Enter the bedroom at the end of the hallway, walking past the bed on your right. Turn right, passing a floor lamp on your left, and stop in front of the window with the wardrobe area on your right.

Turn left into the hallway, leaving the wall with the abstract green painting on your right. Walk straight down the hallway. Enter the room ahead, passing a potted plant on your left and a bed with a dark headboard on your right. Stop in front of the window, with the dark storage unit on your right.

Turn right into the hallway, with the green abstract painting on the wall to your right. Walk straight down the hallway. Then, turn right into the open room. Walk forward, keeping the dining table with green chairs to your left, and pass the light-colored cabinet with the beverage cooler and the long dark console table, both on your left. Continue into the living room, and stop in front of the window, with the television and TV console to your left.

Turn right from the window, passing the TV and console on your left. Walk towards the hallway opening on your right. Enter the hallway, with a large white and black wardrobe on your right. Proceed straight down the hallway, passing a green geometric picture on your right wall. At the end of the hallway, turn left into the dining area. Walk forward, keeping the dining table and chairs on your left, and stop in front of the dining table with the kitchen area to your left.

Go through the doorway into the hallway, then continue straight, passing an open room on your left. Walk straight down the hallway, passing a door on your right. Enter the bedroom at the end of the hallway, and walk towards the window in front of you. Stop in front of the window, with a closet on your right.

Walk forward past the hallway on your left. Continue past the bathroom doorway on your right, then turn right to enter the room with the bunk beds. Walk further into the room and stop with the bunk bed on your right and the desk under the window on your left.

Walk forward into the living room, passing the sectional sofa on your left and the TV on your right. After the TV, turn right and walk straight, passing the kitchen on your right, to enter the hallway. Proceed straight down the hallway. Turn right into the room on your right, stopping in front of the washing machine and sink.

Walk forward towards the doorway with the wardrobe on your right. Go through the doorway and turn left into the hallway. Walk straight down the hallway, then turn right to enter the open living and dining area. Walk past the dining table on your right and the sofa on your left. Continue forward, passing the TV on your left, and stop in front of the large window.

Walk forward into the living room, passing the white couch and coffee table on your left, with the TV and its media console on your right. Continue straight, then turn left, passing the large grey sofa on your left. Stop in front of the dining table, with the white bookshelf visible behind it.

Turn right towards the open doorway on your right. Walk straight through the doorway into the hallway. Turn right into the next doorway on your right, with a room containing bunk beds on your left. Walk straight into the bathroom, passing the toilet on your left and the shower enclosure on your right. Turn right to face the doorway leading out of the bathroom. Walk straight through this doorway into the bedroom, passing a closet on your right. Continue walking straight, passing the bed on your right, and stop in front of the dressing table with a mirror on your left.

Turn right through the doorway to enter the hallway with herringbone flooring. Walk straight down the hallway, passing the doorway to the striped hallway on your left. Continue straight, passing the doorway to the bunk bed room on your left and the bathroom on your right. Turn left into the room with the bunk beds. Walk forward towards the window, and stop in front of the desk with the bunk bed on your right and the white wardrobe on your left.

Enter the hallway. Walk straight, passing a window on your left and a row of cabinets on your left, with wardrobes on your right. Turn left into the open room. Walk forward, passing a dining table with chairs on your right. Proceed straight into the living room, keeping a TV wall on your left and a large sofa on your right. Continue walking straight towards the large windows and stop in the corner of the room, with the white air conditioner unit on your right.

Walk through the doorway into the open living space. Proceed straight, keeping the kitchen island on your right. Continue past a wall of white cabinets on your right and a dark, reflective wall on your left. Keep walking straight, passing a golden partition wall on your right, which separates the living room on your left from the dining room on your right. Turn left to enter the living room area. Walk forward, keeping the long sofa and a black coffee table on your left, and the partition wall with artwork on your right. Pass the chaise lounge chair on your left. Stop in front of the large window that overlooks the water, with white cabinets on your left.

From your current position, turn left, passing the kitchen island on your left and the white cabinet unit on your right. Walk straight forward, keeping the kitchen island with a sink on your left and the dark kitchen cabinets on your right. Stop in front of the double doors directly ahead.

Walk forward through the doorway into the dining room, passing the round dining table. As you continue, a living room with a sofa will appear on your left. Turn left at the end of the dining area, keeping the living room on your right and a tall dark cabinet on your left. Walk straight into the kitchen, with the long kitchen counter and sink appearing on your left. Stop in front of the sink, with the kitchen counter and cabinets on your left.

Enter the room. Walk forward, keeping the kitchen island on your right. Turn left to move away from the kitchen area, then walk straight with the tall white cabinet storage unit on your left. Stop in front of the living room area, facing the sofa and coffee table.

Walk through the doorway and enter the kitchen. Proceed straight, keeping the kitchen island on your left and tall white cabinets on your right. Continue walking into the living room, passing a sofa on your left and a decorative partition wall on your right. Walk forward towards the large window, with a lounge chair on your left, and stop directly in front of the window.

Walk through the doorway and enter the kitchen, keeping the kitchen island on your right. Continue straight, passing the kitchen island on your left and a paneled wall on your right, to enter the living room. Walk straight through the living room, passing the sofa on your left and the decorative divider wall on your right, towards the large window ahead. Turn left to face the window, with cabinets on your left, and stop in front of the window.

Walk forward through the doorway, keeping the TV on the console to your right. Turn left to enter the living and dining area. Walk straight, passing the dining table on your left and the sofa with the coffee table on your right. Then, turn left into the kitchen doorway. Continue straight into the kitchen and stop in front of the sink, which is below the window.

Walk forward past the tall cabinet on your left and the console with the TV on your right. Go through the doorway ahead, then turn right into the open dining and living area. Walk straight, keeping the dining table on your left and the living room sofa on your right. Turn left to enter the kitchen, then walk straight ahead. Stop in front of the kitchen counter with the stove.

Walk forward through the doorway, keeping the large TV on your left and the wardrobe on your right. Continue straight through the short passage. Upon exiting the passage, turn left to enter the open living area. Walk forward past the dining table on your left and the living room furniture on your right, then turn left to enter the kitchen. Stop in front of the stove and oven, with the refrigerator on your left.

Walk forward, keeping the TV and its console on your right. Continue straight, passing the bed and large wardrobe on your left, and then go through the doorway ahead. Upon exiting the doorway, turn right to enter the dining room. Walk straight through the dining room, keeping the dining table and chairs on your left, and enter the living room. Turn right towards the sofa and coffee table, then stop in front of the TV mounted on the wall, with the long console table below it.

From your current position, with the bathroom on your left, turn right to face the dining and living room area. Walk straight past the dining table on your left and the living room on your right. Turn left into the open doorway to enter the kitchen. Walk forward into the kitchen, keeping the refrigerator on your left, and stop in front of the stove.

Walk forward from the bedroom, through the doorway. Turn left to enter the dining and living room area. Walk straight through this area, keeping the dining table on your left and the couch on your right. Then, turn left into the kitchen and stop in front of the counter with the stove.

Walk forward, passing the refrigerator on your left. Continue straight through the dining area, keeping the dining table on your right and the living room with the sofa on your left. Proceed past the living room, then turn right into the hallway. Turn left to enter the bathroom, and walk forward, stopping in front of the toilet with the shower on your left.

Walk forward, keeping the TV and entertainment console on your right. Pass the dining table on your right, then turn left through the open doorway. Enter the room and walk straight forward, passing the potted plant on your left. Stop in front of the long wooden table, facing the bookcase.

Walk forward through the doorway to enter the living room. Turn left, keeping the dining area to your right. Continue turning left until the sofa and coffee table are on your right, and then stop in front of the television and bookshelf.

Turn left. Continue turning left, passing a dining table and then an opening to a kitchen area on your left. Keep turning until you are facing the living room's TV wall. Walk forward towards the television, and stop directly in front of it, with the tall bookshelf on your right.

Exit the bathroom, passing the sink on your right, and walk straight into the living room, keeping the couch and coffee table on your left. Turn right into the hallway, then walk forward to enter the second bathroom, with the toilet in front of you and the sink and shower on your left. Turn around and exit the bathroom, walking past a cabinet with artwork on your left. Continue straight through the dining area, keeping the dining table and chairs on your left, and then turn right to enter the kitchen. Walk forward and stop in front of the sink, beneath the window.

Enter the room. Turn left, passing the dining table and bench on your right. Walk straight through the living room, keeping the television and bookshelf on your left and the sofa and coffee table on your right. Stop in front of the large window.

Walk straight forward through the hallway, passing the dining area on your left and the bathroom entrance on your right. Continue straight past a black console table on your right, then turn right to enter the living room. Stop in front of the dark gray sofa, with the white coffee table and round pouf between you and the sofa.

Walk straight forward, passing the open wardrobe on your left. Continue straight through the hallway, passing a first open doorway on your right, followed by a second open doorway also on your right. Then, pass a black console table on your right. Turn left to enter the living room, and stop in front of the dark gray sofa on your left.

Walk forward in the hallway, passing a dark console table on your right. Continue past the entrance to the bathroom on your right. Turn left to enter the dining room, passing a tall white cabinet on your left. Walk towards the dining table. Stop in front of the dining table, with the kitchen visible through the doorway ahead.

Turn left to enter the living room. Walk forward, passing a black console table with an Eiffel Tower painting on your left. Continue straight through the living room, keeping the dark grey sofa and coffee table on your left, and the TV with its stand on your right, until you reach the window. Stop in front of the dark grey sofa.

Walk straight through the hallway, keeping the counter on your left and passing an open doorway on your right. Continue forward into the living room, then turn left. Stop in front of the doorway with the Eiffel Tower picture on the wall to your right.

Turn right into the hallway, keeping the open closet on your left. Walk straight down the hallway, passing two doorways on your right. Then, turn left to enter the living room, with a black console table on your right. Continue walking forward, passing a dark sofa and a round coffee table on your left. Stop in front of the television.

Walk past the dining table on your left, keeping the dark shelving unit on your right. Continue straight past the closed door, also on your right. Stop in front of the large window overlooking the water.

Execute a continuous right turn from your initial position. During this turn, pass the kitchen area and a dark brown door on your right. Continue turning right, moving into the living room area, passing a dark statue on a pedestal, and then a wall-mounted TV, both on your right. Stop facing the expansive window that overlooks the outdoor scenery, with two lounge chairs directly in front of you.

Walk forward into the living room, passing the white shelving unit on your right. Proceed straight, keeping the dark, illuminated alcove on your left. Continue forward through the living room, passing the large L-shaped sofa and the round coffee table on your left. Angle slightly right and stop between the two armchairs and the large window ahead of you.

Walk straight through the kitchen, keeping the kitchen counter on your left and passing the dining table on your right. Continue forward until you reach the window at the end of the room, then turn right. Proceed forward with the large window on your left and stop in front of the marble-topped counter, with the ornate shelving behind it.

Walk forward past the dining table on your left and a shelf wall on your right. Continue straight until the curtains are drawn across the window on your left, then stop in front of the closed curtains, with the shelf wall to your right.

Walk forward, keeping a sculpture on a pedestal on your left. Continue straight through the open space, passing a dining table on your right. Proceed straight along the kitchen counter on your left and a bar area with large windows on your right. Stop in front of the window at the far end of the room.
Turn left into the hallway. Walk straight, passing the living room on your right, and stop in front of the doorway ahead.

Walk forward, passing a room with brown curtains and chairs on your left. Continue straight, keeping the living room with a TV on the left wall and a sofa on your right. Go through the doorway directly ahead into a hallway. Walk straight down the hallway. When you reach a junction with a doorway to a bedroom on your left, turn right into the doorway directly ahead of you. Enter the room and stop in front of the large wooden desk on your right, facing the window.

Walk forward, keeping the dining table and a window with curtains on your left. Continue straight, passing a long wall with a TV and a potted plant on your left, and a living room area with sofas and a coffee table on your right. Go through the doorway ahead to enter a hallway. Walk down the hallway, passing an open doorway to a bedroom on your left. Turn right into the room with wooden floors. Stop in front of the window, with the desk on your right.

From the bedroom, turn left to face the hallway. Walk forward, passing a bathroom entrance on your left. Turn right to enter the living room. Walk straight through the living room, with a sofa and coffee table on your left, and a large plant on your right. Turn right into the next room, which has wooden flooring. Stop in front of the wall with curtains on your left, facing the opposite wall with a large screen on your right.

Turn left into the open area. Walk forward through this room, passing a television on your left and a large wooden sofa on your right, under the chandelier. Go through the doorway at the end of the room to enter a narrow hallway. Then, turn right into the room with wooden floors, and stop in front of the desk with the horse statue, facing the window.

From your current position, turn right to enter the main hallway. Walk straight down the hallway, passing the dark opening on your left and then the kitchen island on your left. Continue straight into the living room. Stop in front of the large windows that overlook the lake, with the sofa on your left and the entertainment unit on your right.

Walk straight, keeping the tall wardrobe on your left and the black screen on the wall to your right, then go through the doorway. Continue walking straight into the bedroom. Stop in front of the nightstand on the right side of the bed.

Enter the doorway in front of you into the bedroom. Once inside the bedroom, turn right to face the hallway. Walk straight down the hallway, passing the bedroom entrance on your left. Continue straight into the combined kitchen and living room area, keeping the kitchen island on your left. Turn left towards the wall unit with shelves. Stop in front of the wall unit with the framed artwork on the marble wall.

Walk straight through the doorway. Immediately after passing through the doorway, turn right into a hallway. Walk straight down the hallway, passing the living room area on your right and a kitchen counter on your left. Turn right into the kitchen, and stop in front of the sink under the window.

Exit the room by going through the doorway. Immediately turn right to enter the hallway. Walk straight down the hallway, passing the opening to a bedroom on your left and then a kitchen counter on your left. At the end of the hallway, turn right into the kitchen area, with a large pillar on your left and a refrigerator on your right. Walk forward, keeping the refrigerator on your left, and stop in front of the sink, directly facing the window.

Walk forward out of the doorway. Pass the living room on your left and the dining area with the table and chairs on your right. Then, turn right into the hallway, keeping the cabinetry on your right, and stop in front of the closed wooden door.

Walk forward, keeping the dining area and living room on your right. Turn left into the doorway. Walk straight through the doorway into the bedroom, keeping the bed on your left and the TV and desk on your right. Stop in front of the window.

Walk forward into the dining area, keeping the white shelved wall on your right. Continue straight, passing the dining table on your right. Turn left to enter the doorway. Walk straight through the doorway into the bedroom, and stop with the bed on your left and the TV on the wall to your right.

From the room with the desk on your left and a plant on your right, walk straight forward and turn slightly right to go through the doorway. Enter the hallway, then turn left at the first doorway on your left. Enter the bathroom and stop in front of the sink, with the toilet to your right and the window straight ahead.

Walk forward through the doorway, keeping a wall with white panels on your right. Continue straight, passing the kitchen area on your left, and then turn right to enter the bathroom. Walk forward and stop in front of the sink with the mirror above it.

Walk forward, keeping the television on your left. Continue straight, passing a bed frame on your left, and go through the open doorway. Enter the living room. Turn right, with a coffee table on your right, to face the large windows. Walk forward, passing the TV and media console on your left, and stop directly in front of the large windows overlooking the water.

Walk forward through the room, keeping a dining table with chairs on your left and the living room with the couch, coffee table, and TV on your right. Gradually turn left towards the wall. Proceed straight past the first open doorway on your left. Stop in front of the second open doorway on your left, which leads to a bathroom.

Walk forward to enter the living area, passing a dining table and chairs on your right. Continue straight, keeping a large couch on your right, and pass a doorway to a washroom on your left. Then, pass another doorway leading to a bedroom, also on your left. Turn left towards the wall with the TV and media console. Walk past the media console on your left, and stop in front of the window.

Walk forward into the open-plan room, passing a dining table and chairs on your right, then continue straight past a bathroom entrance on your left. Enter the living room and turn right to face the large windows, stopping in front of the sofa with the television on your left.

Enter the large open room. Walk forward, keeping the dining table and chandelier on your right and the sofa on your left. Continue walking forward until a large TV and media console are directly ahead of you, with the sofa now on your right. Turn 90 degrees left, so you are facing the wall with the TV. Walk straight forward, passing the TV and media console on your left, and stop directly in front of the windows.

Walk forward through the doorway. Pass the kitchen on your right and the dining table on your left to enter the living room. Turn left, walking past the couch on your right and the coffee table. Stop in front of the light-colored wooden door.

Turn left to enter the hallway, with a large wardrobe on your right. Walk straight down the hallway, passing an open room with a desk and computer on your right. Continue straight to enter the open living area, with a dining table and chairs on your left. Stop in front of the sofa, with a coffee table between you and the sofa.

Enter the dining area from the doorway, with a kitchen counter on your immediate right. Walk forward, keeping a console table with artwork on your left. Continue straight, passing the dining table on your right. Enter the living room, then turn slightly right to face a white cabinet. Stop in front of the white cabinet, with a wooden door to its left.

Turn right, passing the dining area on your right. Walk straight into the narrow passage. Keep the kitchen area with the washing machine on your left. Continue straight through the passage and stop in front of the window, with the stacked washer and dryer unit on your left.

Walk forward through the narrow corridor, keeping the cabinet on your right. Pass through the doorway, continuing straight between the office on your left and the bedroom on your right. Proceed further into the main living area, with the dining table and chairs on your left and a brown couch on your right. Stop in front of the brown couch.

Enter the living room. Walk straight, keeping the large L-shaped couch and coffee table on your left. Continue forward, passing a TV on your right and a white console cabinet with a painting on your left, to enter the dining area. Pass the dining table with chairs on your right, then stop in front of the large window on your left.

Turn right to face an open doorway, with a wardrobe on your left and a bed on your right. Walk straight through the doorway to enter the living room, passing a large sectional sofa and a coffee table on your left. Continue walking forward, then turn right to face another open area, with a TV cabinet on your right. Walk straight ahead into the dining room. Proceed towards the dining table, with a large window on your left, and stop directly in front of the dining table.

Walk forward from the kitchen. Pass the dining table on your right and the tall cabinet with the bar area on your left. Turn slightly left to enter the living room. Walk further into the living room, keeping the TV on your left and the couch on your right. Stop facing the window.

From the bedroom, turn left to enter the living room, passing the bed on your right. Walk straight through the living room, keeping the large sofa and coffee table on your left and the TV console on your right. Continue straight into the dining area, with the dining table and chairs on your left and a bar cabinet on your right. Go through the doorway ahead to enter the kitchen, and stop in front of the window above the sink.

Enter the living room, turning slightly right. Walk forward, keeping the coffee table and couch on your left and the TV on your right. Turn right into the hallway, with a console table on your left. Walk straight down the hallway, passing the dining table on your left and a wine rack cabinet on your right. Continue straight into the kitchen, and stop in front of the sink and window.

Walk forward, keeping the dark brown wall on your left and passing the kitchen island and dining area on your right. Enter the doorway straight ahead into the living room. Continue walking straight through the living room, with the kitchen cabinets on your left and the TV and sofa on your right. Go through the doorway at the back of the living room. Turn left into the dressing room, passing the cabinet with artwork on your right, and stop in front of the vanity beneath the window.

Walk forward into the hallway, passing a couch on your left and kitchen cabinets on your right. Continue straight, moving past a kitchen island and bookshelves on your left, and a refrigerator on your right. Proceed straight down the hallway, passing the first doorway on your left. Turn left at the second doorway to enter the bedroom. Stop in front of the bed and the window, with a dressing table on your left.

Walk straight through the hallway, passing a room entrance on your left and a white vanity on your right. Continue forward into the open room, keeping the refrigerator on your left and the kitchen island on your right. Walk past the dining table on your left, heading towards the large bookshelf on your right. Stop in front of the window.

Walk forward from your current position, passing the couch on your left and the refrigerator on your right. Proceed straight, keeping the kitchen island on your left. Then, turn left into the dining room, moving past the dining table on your left and the large black bookshelf on your right. Stop in front of the window.

Turn left into the hallway. Walk straight down the hallway, passing the kitchen with a refrigerator and cabinets on your left, and a kitchen island and living room with a TV on your right. Go through the doorway ahead, passing a console with artwork on your left. Continue straight, passing a vanity desk with a window on your left and mirrored closets on your right. Stop in front of the open doorway leading into the bathroom, with a bathtub on your right and a shower on your left.

Walk forward to enter the bathroom, stopping in front of the sink and mirror. Turn right to exit the bathroom, then walk straight down the main hallway, stopping where the decorative floor patterns extend forward.

Walk forward, keeping the large window on your left and the washing machine with a counter on your right. Turn right to enter the bedroom. Walk forward through the bedroom, passing the bed on your left and a mounted TV on your right. Turn right at the end of the bedroom, leaving a large dark wardrobe on your left, and enter the hallway. In the hallway, turn left and walk straight, keeping a living room area with a couch on your left and a decorative cabinet on your right. Proceed straight into the dining room, passing a dining table with chairs on your left and built-in cabinets on your right, and stop in front of the window at the far end of the room.

Walk forward, keeping the sink on your left. Continue straight, passing a dining table on your right, then turn left into the hallway. Walk straight down the hallway, passing a cabinet on your left. Enter the living room, walking towards the TV on the right-hand wall and passing a couch on your left. Turn right into the doorway to enter the bedroom. Move towards the bed in front of you, then turn right. Walk past the TV on your left, then enter the utility room through the doorway on your right, with the washing machine and sink on your right. Stop in front of the window ahead.
Turn left from the hallway, moving into the open area. Walk forward, keeping the dining room with its table and chairs on your right. Continue straight and stop in front of the kitchen counter.

Turn right from your current position, keeping the television on your right-hand side. Walk straight forward, passing the television on your left and a large, dark wardrobe on your right. Go through the open doorway ahead and stop just inside, with the vanity and mirror on your left.

Exit the bathroom doorway, turning right into the room with wooden floors. Walk straight past the hexagonal shelves on your left, then turn right to enter the living room, passing a chaise lounge on your left and a dining table with yellow chairs on your right. Walk straight through the living room and go through the doorway ahead. Continue straight down the tiled hallway with a tall white cabinet on your left, and stop in front of the closed door at the end of the hallway.

Go through the doorway on your left, passing a dark closet on your right. Turn right into the hallway. Walk straight down the hallway, passing a white brick wall and an orange armchair on your left. Turn left into the living room. Walk forward and stop in front of the grey sofa.

Go through the doorway into the open living and kitchen area. Turn right into the hallway, passing the kitchen on your left and the living room with the couch on your right. Walk straight down the hallway, passing the bathroom entrance on your right and the storage room doorway on your left. Continue straight, passing an office doorway on your right. At the end of the hallway, with the framed picture on the wall in front of you and the stairs on your right, turn left into the bedroom. Walk straight, keeping the closet on your left and the bed on your right, and stop in front of the window with the curtains.

Turn left and go through the doorway. Walk forward, passing a sink on your left and white brick walls on both sides, with a living room visible to your right. Continue straight through the next doorway to enter the bathroom. Stop in front of the window, with the toilet on your left.

Turn left to enter the dining room, keeping the wall with the hexagonal shelves on your right. Walk forward through the dining area, passing the dining table and chairs on your left. Continue straight ahead towards the kitchen area, which appears on your right. Stop in front of the kitchen counter, with the sink directly ahead of you.

Turn left to face the doorway. Walk through the doorway to enter a hallway with grey tiled flooring, which transitions to light wood. Continue straight down the hallway, passing a shower area on your left and dark grey wardrobes on your right. Enter the bedroom at the end of the hallway, walking past the bed on your left. Turn right and stop in front of the large window.

Turn left to enter the doorway. Walk straight through the short hallway, passing a bedroom entrance on your left. Turn right to enter the living room, walking past a sofa on your left. Stop in front of the window, with the TV on your right.

From the bathroom, turn left and go through the doorway, passing the sink and toilet on your right. Proceed forward through the area with built-in cupboards on your right and straight ahead, then turn left into a bedroom. Walk straight past the bed on your left, and stop in front of the large window.

From your current position, turn left to face the doorway. Go through the doorway into the entrance area, then walk forward, passing a closed door on your left and a kitchen/dining area on your right. Continue straight into the hallway, passing an opening to a room with a white marble wall on your left. Go through the next doorway straight ahead, then turn right to enter a bedroom. Walk forward with the bed on your left and the wardrobes on your right, and stop in front of the window.

From the bathroom, walk forward, passing the sink and mirror on your right, and go through the doorway. Turn right into the hallway, with the wooden cabinets to your left. Proceed straight down the hallway, passing the bedroom entrance on your right and the bathroom entrance on your left. Continue straight into the open living area, with a kitchen and dining table visible on your right. Stop in front of the TV, with the sofa to your left.
